high_level_description: This image depicts an elegant outdoor event set up on a rooftop at night. The setting is sophisticated and festive, with a long, rectangular table adorned with white linens, clear glassware, and vibrant floral centerpieces in shades of pink, orange, and yellow. The table is meticulously set with plates, napkins, cutlery, and small candles, suggesting a formal dinner or celebration. The chairs surrounding the table are modern and transparent, adding to the contemporary aesthetic of the event. In the background, there is a large illuminated sign that reads "TIFFANY & CO.
